name: Infested Attendant

source.title: Pathfnder Society Scenario #7-21: The Home of Empty Breath

items.name: Slow
items.text: A sulfur zombie is permanently Slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

items.name: Death Throes
items.text: When a sulfur zombie dies, its body explodes in a 30-foot burst of fire and debris that deals 2d10 bludgeoning,2d10 piercing to each creature in the area (DC 21 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Blinding Sulfur
items.text: A sulfur zombie burns with putrid inner fire. A creature hit by a sulfur zombie's fist Strike must attempt a DC 22 Fortitude save save. On a failure, the creature is Blinded for 1 round, or for 1 minute on a critical failure.

items.name: Infested
items.text: The zombie is filled with squirming rust-red beetles as well as alchemical sulfur, not fire. It loses the immunity to fire, and its Death Throes and fist Strikes deal piercing damage in place of fire damage.

text:
Glowing with a dull amber light, these odious creatures spawn from a combination of baleful magic and fire. These destructive creations sow chaos and demolish fortifications, making them the bane of besieged cities.

---
Necromancers most often create these mindless undead as obedient, expendable servitors. Left to its own devices, a zombie seeks only to consume the living, stopping only when its rotting body can no longer hold together.
